tasks.CalculateTotalMarbles: Calculate the total number of marbles in the bag before any changes are made.
tasks.DefineVariables: Define the number of blue marbles as B and yellow marbles as Y based on given ratio.
tasks.SetInitialEquation: Formulate an equation using initial conditions (B/Y = 4/3).
tasks.SolveSystemOfEquations: Solve the system of equations to find initial number of blue marbles B.
tasks.UpdateEquationAfterChange: Adjust the equation after adding 5 blue marbles and removing 3 yellow marbles (B+5)/(Y-3) = 7/3.
